title: Betti numbers of split graphs
summary: A split graph is a graph where the vertices are a disjoint union of a complete part $C=\{x_i,\ldots,x_n\}$ and a stable part $S=\{y_1,\ldots,y_m\}$. We will determine the Betti numbers of the edge ring of all split graphs, in particular show that the only nonzero Betti numbers are $β_{0,0}$ and $β_{i,i+1}$, $i>0$. The Betti numbers only depend on the multiset of the number of neighbors in $S$ the $x_i$'s have.
